text: Real study plans for the two foundation credentials, built around the Trailhead catalog as it exists right now.
This is Trailhead's actual live certification catalog -- the Accredited Professional and Associate tracks, and the role-based paths every credential sits inside.
Trailhead groups its credentials by role. Administrator, Architect, Developer, and more -- each one opens its own catalog of relevant certifications.

Here are the foundation credentials by their real, current names: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator, Platform Administrator the second, and Platform App Builder -- not whatever older name you might remember from a blog post.

Study with your capstone, not against it. Start from what your LTV Customer Management System already covers. Follow Trailhead's own curated Trailmix. Rebuild any weak spot hands-on, with no guide open. And save the practice exam for last, as a readiness check.
Next lesson: the same discipline, applied to the Developer and Architect tracks.
